derivation: tools/web/bass5_inputs.py: tools/wsp/ext/bass1_cases.py readers and geometry with the bass1_cases_v3.py flow coding, law_inputs.py bass5_row(c, 'sustain'); conditions only

x_o2.source: PSI-26: as-run matrix 'O2 % by volume' (written as a fraction); PSI-25: test matrix 'Calibrated initial O2 % by vol' / 100. Volume fraction taken as mole fraction

flow_speed.source: duct speed of the first flow step: the burn's anemometer reading ('Air display', x 1.0066) when it is >= 2 cm/s and pairs with the fan cell, else the fan display or pot setting of the 'Fan display' cell through the burn's fan curve; cm/s / 100

nose_radius.source: rods, spheres, sections: diameter from the material text (rod inch fractions, sphere cm; spherical section 4 cm) / 2; flat samples 0.01

heat_time.source: 200: no planned igniter on-time is recorded for any BASS burn (bass1_sustain_row)

is_concurrent.source: flat samples: 1 concurrent, 0 opposed, from the configuration words (material, igniter, distance cells; PSI-25: Summary Report Appendix A); fabrics with no stated direction 0.5; rods, spheres, sections 0

is_rod.source: 1 if the material text names a rod

flat_thickness.source: flat PMMA: thickness from the material text (micron or mm; PSI-26 slabs 2 mm per the SRD); SIBAL 0.00032, Nomex 0.0003, Ultem 0.00025; rods, spheres, sections 0.0005

u_pot1.source: the burn's fan curve (BASS-II Reference Data fan calibrations: the day's own block, else the campaign median for the restrictor count) at fan display 46.5, / 100

is_one_sided.source: flat PMMA: 1 if the material text says one side burns (PSI-26 slabs one-sided per the SRD); fabrics, rods, spheres, sections 0

is_sibal.source: 1 if the material text names SIBAL

is_nomex_ultem.source: 1 if the material text names Nomex or Ultem

flat_width.source: PMMA films and slabs: width from the material text ('2 cm wide'; PSI-26 slabs 1 cm per the SRD); everything else, and a flat PMMA sample with no width recorded, 0.02
